model_output.verdict: A healthcare operations executive with substantial growth and operating results attached.
write_up: This is a standout executive resume! A recruiter can see the 140-practice operation you lead, the growth from 38 practices, and the improvement in same-store EBITDA margin.

The integration playbook line is a great model: it names the change you made and the drop from 7 months to 10 weeks. Your resume isn't likely to be the reason you don't get a call back. How competitive the role is and whether you have a referral can still matter.

cards.line: - Cut new-practice integration time from 7 months to 10 weeks by standardizing the 90-day integration playbook
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this line. It puts the before and after next to the method, so a recruiter can see what your work changed.

fit.note: Your experience points to healthcare operations leadership across multi-site organizations. The current role shows responsibility for a large practice network, its operating plan and its P&L.
